title: Map original indices after normalized duplicate deletions
goal: Repair map_after_deletions(length, removed). length is a nonnegative integer and removed is a list of integer indices into the ORIGINAL sequence of that length. Accept Python-style negative indices in [-length, length); normalize negatives by adding length. Reject a negative length or any out-of-range index with ValueError, including every attempted deletion from length zero. Duplicate indices, including a negative index and its equivalent positive index, delete that original position only once. Return a new list of exactly length entries: entry i is None if original index i is deleted, otherwise it is the zero-based position of that element among surviving elements in original order. Validate every index. Do not modify removed. Preserve the signature.
constraints: Do not add files, dependencies, or modify tests.
Keep map_after_deletions and its signature unchanged.

provenance.public_tests: Authored specification examples and diagnostic boundary cases
provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct inputs and bounded independent surviving-index enumeration
